newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni shares undervalued - CSFB.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni shares undervalued - CSFB.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the largest Czech commercial bank, has solid provisioning levels for doubtful loans and its shares remain a buy, Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) said in a report on Tuesday.
CSFB said the shares, which lost 77 crowns on Tuesday to close at 2,222, were worth buying at up to 3,000 crowns, while the bank's GDRs, at 28.56 in London on Tuesday, were interesting up to $40.
The investment bank said that Komercni 1996 results, which some analysts said were rather disappointing due to a small increase in profits, were in line with CSFB's expectations.
Net profit, according to international accounting standards, rose to 5.24 billion crowns from 5.11 billion in 1995.
"We believe that Komercni continues to be undervalued," the report said.
CSFB said that it believed Komercni's loan portfolio has been improving and that its proportion of non-performing new loans -- at five percent since 1995 -- was low by regional standards.
"As these new loans make up an increasingly larger proportion of Komercni's total loan portfolio, we expect the overall non-performing loans figures to drop markedly," the report said.
The total proportion of Komercni's non-performing loans decreased by five percentage points last year to 26 percent.

CSFB said that Komercni's combined reserves specific to loans and general of 25.8 billion crowns at the end of 1996, were sufficient considering the realisable collateral, which could bring higher-than-expected proceeds as the real estate market rises.
It added that general reserves, at 6.5 billion, were more than sufficient as risk exposure has decreased since the end of 1995 when general reserves stood at 6.2 billion.

Bad loans are often viewed as the main problem of most Czech banks. Non-performing credits mostly originated at the beginning of the country's reform process when newly-created commercial banks lacked proper risk management and relevant information on clients.
